gamerule.customgamerules.tnt_explodes.de: If false, the TNT explosion does no damage to the world
gamerule.customgamerules.respawn_blocks_: Prevents beds/respawn anchors from exploding in other dimensions
If false, these explosions do no damage to the world
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_biome_f: Disable water freezing due to biome temperature
If true, water placed in the world will not freze by natural means, either biome, temperature, or elevation
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_block_g: Gravity related blocks will not fall when placed or updated  (sand, gravel, concrete, ...)
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_critica: Applies to all regular critical hits made
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_crop_gr: Crops do not grow naturally from time passing (wheat, cactus, etc), however bonemeal does still work
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_sapling: Saplings growth is blocked, both from nature and from bonemeal
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_decay_l: Natural leaf decay turned off, even if not placed by a player
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_decay_c: Coral blocked from going grey when dry
Players hunger bar is hidden, and it is always treated as full.  Food items are unchanged
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_farmlan: Farmland is as strong as dirt, trampling does not destroy it
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_generat: No cobblestone or stone generated from lava and water touching
When source lava blocks get wet, it stays lava and does not become obsidian
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_light_m: Disable ice melting from things like light levels
Ice will not melt from things like sunlight and torches
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_mob_ite: Disable item pickup when any Mob joins the world
This gamerule is applied to mobs as they are loaded into the world, and blocks them from picking up items
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_pet_fri: If an animal is tamed, its owner cannot harm it (horses, cats, parrots, ...)
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_village: The villager trading window cannot be opened by players
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_targeti: Mobs still spawn but treat players invisible, they do not track or target players (AI only; no spawning changes; any difficulty)
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_lightni: Disable mobs from transforming when struck by lightning
Lightning will not mutate anything (charged creepers, villagers, etc)
gamerule.customgamerules.disable_portal_: Portals can still be entered but not ignited
Portals can still be entered, but players cannot socket ender eyes into the portal frame
gamerule.customgamerules.do_armor_stand_: Allow armor stands to have arms
Sneak-right-click to swap main and offhand with armor stand
gamerule.customgamerules.do_cactus_growt: Cactus can grow past 3 up to 256 tall
gamerule.customgamerules.do_maps_always_: All maps in inventory update as if held by player
gamerule.customgamerules.do_eyes_always_: Ender Eyes always break when thrown
Ender Eye will break every time and not drop after thrown
gamerule.customgamerules.do_instant_eati: No food eating delay, is consumed right away
Player can instantly pickup every XP orb with no delay
gamerule.customgamerules.do_sugar_growth: Sugar cane grows past 3 up to 256 tall
gamerule.customgamerules.do_lilypads_bre: Lily Pads break and prevent falldamage
Lily Pads break when player falls on them, preventing damage
gamerule.customgamerules.do_nether_void_: The roof of the nether is treated the same as below and void damage is dealt
gamerule.customgamerules.do_friendly_iro: Iron golems never harm or target players
gamerule.customgamerules.keep_inventory_: If this is false and keepInventory=true, then drop armor on death
If this is false and keepInventory=true, then lose all XP on death
